items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: And then there was Willie the Lion with his hat and cigar, he'd tell Fats, get up from there...

ctx.x: And then there was Willie the Lion with his hat and cigar, he'd tell Fats, get up from there, you know, and that was what the people, really mostly knocked

more so by that, than then what they were playing, because they all played, you can't get away from that, they all played, but I mean it was the comedy part of it that was funny, when the cat walked it they say, get off here, who is that down there. Get off there, you know all that, then they'd just started playing and the drinks was flying and the place, you know, would be in an uproar over that sort of thing. I think all the guys were playing.

items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I heard James P., and Willie the Lion Smith, and Fats Waller.

ctx.x: Who did you hear at these cutting contests?
I heard all of them. I heard James P., and Willie the Lion Smith, and Fats Waller.
